author: Victoria Sanderson
title: Election season begins with first filings - NewsBreak
text: ROBESON COUNTY — The Robeson County Board of Elections opened filing for the upcoming municipal elections on July 7. All parties interested in running for an open position may file their intention to run with the BOE during business hours. As of noon, Tuesday, the candidates for each town within the county are as follows: FAIRMONT Mayor -Charles Kemp -Phillip Wall Council Member -Emily Duke Oxendine LUMBERTON District 8 Council Member -Owen Thomas MARIETTA Mayor -Walter Powell PEMBROKE Council Member - Larry McNeill RED SPRINGS Mayor - Duron Burney Council member -Kecia Mcrae Mccallum - Ellion Donte McQueen - James Carthen II ST. PAULS Mayor - Gerard “Jerry” Weindel District 1 Council Member - John Gudauskas Jr. District 2 Council Member - Mary Singleton The BOE will be accepting candidacy filings until noon on July 18.
